conditions.evidence: This is a schizophrenia in ultimatum game task study
conditions.label: schizophrenia

modalities.evidence: 128 electrode EEG was recorded during the task

output.population: 19 patients with psychosis episodes and 24 healthy controls
output.summary: EEG recorded while patients with psychosis episodes and healthy controls played the ultimatum game as both responder and proposer, three blocks per role, at Fribourg University in Switzerland.
